reason: I forget the bottle on the counter all the time, but a foil sachet I can toss in my bag and take wherever I am tonight actually fits how I live. At $24.99 for the first box I'd try one, not two.
objection: It's still two capsules every day, and if I skip a few nights the box just sits in my bag. Also Made in China makes me want to see that lab report for real.
